propositions: AGENTS.md Module-size policy section documents the 800-LOC gate but omits mention of the shrink-only C901 cyclomatic-complexity ratchet enforced by scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py as part of make lint

Adding CLI flags or guard clauses predictably triggers C901 complexity ceiling violations in existing functions, causing unplanned extraction work at pre-flight even when total LOC remains under the module-size cap

The complexity ratchet uses per-symbol ceilings from .github/complexity-baseline.json with a threshold of 15 (McCabe max-complexity) and permits no baseline bumps, only behavior-preserving refactoring
Implementers discover the C901 gate only after pushing to CI because it is a structural constraint invisible to behavioral test oracles and linters
